# Flappy Frontier — LLM Documentation Index

> Machine-readable project map for LLM agents. Updated: 2026-07-25.

## STATUS — READ FIRST
- The standalone game is RETIRED. The playable game was ported natively into EF-Map (Diabolacal/EF-Map, branch feat/flappy-frontier-games, draft PR #80 — preview-tested, NOT merged, NOT in production).
- Old economics are GONE: no entry fee, no prize pool, no weekly top-3 payout, no token rewards for placement.
- CURRENT on-chain package: contracts/flappy_frontier_v2/ (modules board + game) — coin-free, cycle-agnostic. Testnet package 0x03150b4e0d68ae6a97a97fb47281d40c4f84aeb0182a769c3864ab104db85441, Board 0x9ec1e43310fc4553e33ff75117f361efc6d40cb8c3789f2121b6cb2860635e21.
- DEPRECATED: contracts/flappy_frontier/ (v1), its Treasury, the old-cycle EVE type 0x2a66...::EVE::EVE, and the flappy-frontier-sponsor Cloudflare Worker.
- Revive purchases (100 EVE at death) run through the separate Frontier Commerce EF Arcade merchant, not this repo.
- Current state: README.md (root) and docs/decision-log.md. Everything else in docs/ is historical.

## Project Identity
- Name: Flappy Frontier
- Type: Historical hackathon submission (EVE Frontier, March 2026) + home of the current flappy_frontier_v2 Move package
- Stack: Canvas 2D + React + Vite (frontend) | Sui Move (contracts) | Cloudflare Pages (deploy)

## Critical Agent Files
- .github/copilot-instructions.md — Repo-wide guardrails, CLI policy, quality gates (MUST READ)
- AGENTS.md — Agent context, project facts, boundaries (MUST READ)
- docs/decision-log.md — Technical decisions log (newest first)

## Documentation Map
- docs/README.md — Documentation index
- docs/strategy/flappy-frontier-product-vision.md — Full product vision, architecture, economic model
- docs/research/capabilities.json — EVE Frontier in-game browser capabilities (787×1198px, Canvas 2D, no wallet)
- docs/core/hackathon-repo-conventions.md — Git workflow, file discipline, naming conventions

## Code Entry Points
- contracts/flappy_frontier_v2/ — CURRENT Sui Move package (board + game, no economics)
- contracts/flappy_frontier/ — DEPRECATED v1 Sui Move package (leaderboard, treasury, game seeding)
- frontend/ — RETIRED standalone React + Canvas 2D game (Pages site now serves a retirement notice)
- vendor/ — Git submodules (world-contracts, builder-scaffold, evevault, builder-documentation)

## Key Constraints
- In-game viewport: 787×1198px portrait, DPR 1, Chrome 122
- No Sui wallet in CEF webview — in-game is free-play only
- Score verification: client-trusted (documented tradeoff)
- sui::random for provably fair seeding
- Weekly automated payouts via Clock + trigger_payout()
